svg.aria-label: Hosted by us, or on your servers. Two ways to run fromHello. fromHello Cloud, recommended: nothing to install, nothing to upgrade. Self-host under AGPL-3.0: run it yourself, with or without us. Data and control, either way: export and erase, automatic suppression, audit log, workspaces and roles, your sending domain, first-party tracking.
